cache-max-entries.description: Number of metadata responses kept in the cache.
cache-max-entries.label: Cache size

cache-ttl-seconds.description: How long metric names, labels and label values are cached.
cache-ttl-seconds.label: Cache TTL

advanced.description: Optional tuning for timeouts, retries and caching. Leave a field empty to use its default.

lm-timeout.description: Time allowed for each LogicMonitor API call, including all chunks of a long time range.
lm-timeout.label: Timeout

max-concurrent-requests.description: API requests this data source can have in flight at once.
max-concurrent-requests.label: Concurrent requests

max-rate-limit-wait-seconds.description: Longest wait for the rate-limit window to reset. Requests that would wait longer fail immediately.
max-rate-limit-wait-seconds.label: Rate-limit wait

max-retry-attempts.description: Includes the first attempt. Retries on rate limiting, 502, 503, 504 and network errors.
max-retry-attempts.label: Attempts per request

query-range-workers.description: Long time ranges are split into 25-day chunks. Number of chunks fetched in parallel per query.
query-range-workers.label: Parallel chunks

advanced.setting-error: Enter a whole number between {{min}} and {{max}}.
advanced.title: Advanced

access-id.description: The access ID of the LMv1 API token.
access-id.label: Access ID

access-key.description: The access key of the LMv1 API token.
access-key.label: Access key

auth.description: Create an API token in LogicMonitor under Settings > Users and Roles > API Tokens.

method.bearer-description: Recommended. A single LogicMonitor API token.
method.label: Authentication method
method.lmv1-description: A LogicMonitor API token made of an access ID and an access key.

auth.title: Authentication

token.description: The bearer token shown when the API token was created.
token.label: Bearer token

account.description: The first part of your portal address. For https://acme.logicmonitor.com, enter acme.
account.error-full-domain: Enter only "acme", not the full domain
account.error-invalid: Use only lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens, without a leading or trailing hyphen
account.label: Account name

parse-modal.body: There is a syntax error, or the query structure cannot be visualized when switching to the builder mode. Parts of the query may be lost.
parse-modal.title: Parsing error: Switch to the builder mode?
